description.narrative:
Article 19 works for a world where all people everywhere can freely express themselves and actively engage in public life without fear of discrimination. Article 19 do this by working on two interlocking freedoms: the Freedom of Expression, and the Freedom of Information (freedom to speak and freedom to know).
1) Work for an internet that respects freedom of expression and reflects the diversity of human experience, that; -counter disinformation and improve media literacy -challenge mass surveillance and demand a ban on biometrics -strengthen legislation to keep data private from governments and Big Tech
2) Protect, empower, and connect silenced voices and dissent, working with; -Communities at risk: human rights defenders, activists, and political dissidents, women, indigenous and racialised people, migrants, religious and ethnic minorities, and LGBTQI+ communities and diaspora -Infomediaries: journalists, social communicators, whistleblowers, media workers, and independent and community media outlets and particularly those reporting on corruption, human rights, and the environment -Civil society, community networks, and social movements: particularly youth, women, minority groups, and those fighting corruption and defending the environment and especially in rural and remote areas
3) Advance policy and law to strengthen and protect expression. Develop policy on new areas impacting freedom of expression, including: -infrastructure; -pluralism and diversity online; -state propaganda; and -disinformation. Article 19 will carry out empirical research, building the evidence base to shape international standards and tailor national solutions.

Artikel 19 arbetar för en värld där alla människor överallt fritt kan uttrycka sig och aktivt engagera sig i det offentliga livet utan rädsla för diskriminering. Artikel 19 gör detta genom att arbeta med två sammankopplade friheter: yttrandefriheten och informationsfriheten.

sida:name.sida:narrative: Stärkt försvar av yttrandefriheten, fria och oberoende medier och ett inkluderande öppet, fritt och säkert internet där mänskliga fri- och rättigheter respekteras, samt ökad säkerhet för oberoende journalister och mediearbetare.
